$description: The IKEA store template's theme (owner Q137): IKEA blue and yellow, Noto Sans and pill buttons, for this template's screens only, through core tokens under [data-template='ikea']. Colours are the brand's public blue #0058A3 and yellow #FFDB00, not copied files. Run npm run tokens after a change.

color.accent.$description: IKEA blue: filled buttons, the selected choice, the bag count

color.accent-hover.$description: The blue, hovered: one step darker (Q134: a derived step, not a misuse of the brand)

color.accent-subtle.$description: A chosen tile or row: a pale blue

color.text-link.$description: Q141: ikea.com text links are ink with an underline, not blue

color.focus.$description: Focus rings: the blue on light pages, the yellow on dark

c.section.tone-tint.$description: The members' offer band: a pale IKEA yellow

font.display.$value: 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

font.text.$value: 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

font.ui.$value: 'Noto Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font.ui.$description: Controls and labels in Noto Sans

c.card.radius.$description: Product and room pictures are square-cornered

color.promo.new-text.$description: A New tag in words over a name: a warm orange, lighter on dark so it reads (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.promo.new.$description: A New tag on a picture: the warm orange (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.promo.new-on.$description: Words on the orange tag (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.promo.offer-text.$description: A Lower price tag in words over a name: the sale red (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.promo.offer.$description: A Lower price tag on a picture, and the lowest-price box offset: the sale red (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.promo.offer-on.$description: Words on the red tag (Q139: promotions, never status)

color.map.highlight-badge.$description: The lowest-price box: IKEA yellow, the brand’s second colour

color.map.highlight-badge-on.$description: The price on the yellow box

c.price.highlight-offset.$description: The lowest-price box’s solid offset in the offer red, IKEA’s stacked-price look (Q139 R4: a theme value, not a part)

color.map.band.$description: The brand band (Q140, Q141): IKEA Family blue, a lighter blue than the logo's: the Family price tags, the Family panel, the offer ticket

color.map.feature.$description: The feature panel (Q140): IKEA yellow blocks, the sale block, the store band, the chat header

color.map.feature-tint.$description: A pale yellow wash for a quiet feature area

radius.sm.$description: Q141: IKEA is square-cornered: pictures, panels, tags, cards. Pills are chosen, not the shape: buttons, chips and the search keep radius.pill

radius.md.$description: Q141: square controls' corners where they aren't pills (menus, list items, fields other than the search)

radius.lg.$description: Q141: square surfaces: pictures (c.image.radius), cards, dialogs

c.badge.radius.$description: Q141: tags on pictures are square boxes (New, Lower price, IKEA Family price)

c.field.radius.$description: Q141: fields are pills on IKEA (the search, the postcode field)

color.bg.$description: Q141: the page is plain white

color.bg-raised.$description: Q141: raised surfaces are white too

color.bg-sunken.$description: Q141: IKEA's light grey: chips, the search, the grey bands, the footer

color.text.$description: Q141: headings, names and labels in IKEA's near-black

color.text-muted.$description: Q141: running text, nav and footer links in IKEA's dark grey

type.body.size.$description: Q141: IKEA's body text is 14 px

type.label.size.$description: Q141: labels and button words at 14 px

c.footer.link.$description: Q141: footer links in the dark grey
